lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2GaSn crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms (Mg4Ga2Sn2) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Ga and Sn each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg has 12 neighbors with a distance range of 3.0419–3.2437 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Ga–Mg pairs sharing edges.
